facts.fact: Use capture_source 'game_view' for screenshots, NOT 'scene_view'. Scene view is the observer's camera. Game view uses Main Camera which I control independently by repositioning it with manage_gameobject modify.
Do NOT enter Play Mode. MCP tools use editor-time APIs that get blocked during Play Mode. Stay in Edit Mode always.
set_renderer_color uses PropertyBlock which may not persist visually. Use manage_material create + assign_material_to_renderer for reliable coloring.
